bibl.title: The ius liberorum of non-Roman citizens in Egypt. Some notes on an old Taubenschlag's hypothesis.
bibl.seg: Carlos María Sánchez-Moreno Ellart, The ius liberorum of non-Roman citizens in Egypt. Some notes on an old Taubenschlag's hypothesis.
bibl.note: I. The nature of the ius liberorum and its evolution. May this right be granted to non-Romans? - II. Meaning and scope of the comparison between the councils of the Spanish charters and the boulai of the metropoleis in Egypt. - III. The meaning of the formulary: the lack of κύριος. - IV. The personal identity of Antonia Thermoutharion and Iulia Koprous. - V. Conclusions.
